title: Finding a Seat in Class
situation: A new student asks where to sit and what to open in class.
somali_situation: Arday cusub ayaa weydiinaya meesha uu fariisto iyo waxa uu fasalka ka furo.

title: Choosing School Subjects
situation: A student asks a counselor which subjects to take this term.
somali_situation: Arday ayaa la-taliye weydiinaya maaddooyinka uu qaadanayo teermkan.
key_phrases: Which subject should I take first?

dialogue.speaker: Student
dialogue.english: Which subject should I take first?

dialogue.speaker: Student
dialogue.english: I want to improve my speaking.

dialogue.speaker: Counselor
dialogue.english: Then English is a good choice.

dialogue.speaker: Counselor
dialogue.somali: Taariikhda goor dambe ayaad qaadan kartaa.

title: Asking About Homework
situation: A student asks what homework is due and how to submit it.
somali_situation: Arday ayaa weydiinaya shaqada guriga ee la rabo iyo sida loo gudbiyo.
key_phrases: Write one paragraph about your family.
Can I submit the assignment online?
The topic is on the board.

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.english: Write one paragraph about your family.
dialogue.somali: Qor hal faqradood oo ku saabsan qoyskaaga.

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.english: The topic is on the board.

dialogue.speaker: Student
dialogue.english: Can I submit the assignment online?
dialogue.somali: Shaqada internetka ma ku gudbin karaa?

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.somali: Shaqo guri oo daahda dhibco ayay lumisaa.

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.somali: Waa fiican tahay. Weedhaha ka dhig kuwo fudud.

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.english: Yes, but write your own sentences.

title: Talking to a Teacher After Class
somali_title: Fasalka ka dib macallin lala hadlayo
situation: A student asks a teacher for advice after struggling with listening practice.
somali_situation: Arday ayaa macallin talo weydiinaya ka dib markii uu ku adkaaday tababarka dhageysiga.
key_phrases: Can I ask for advice after class?
Listening practice is difficult for me.

dialogue.speaker: Student
dialogue.english: Can I ask for advice after class?
dialogue.somali: Fasalka ka dib talo ma weydiin karaa?

dialogue.speaker: Student
dialogue.english: Listening practice is difficult for me.
dialogue.somali: Tababarka dhageysigu wuu igu adag yahay.

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.english: That is normal at this level.

dialogue.speaker: Student
dialogue.english: I miss words when people speak fast.
dialogue.somali: Erayo ayaan seegaa marka dadku dhaqso u hadlaan.

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.somali: Marka hore ku tababar duubisyo gaaban.

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.english: Ten minutes every day is enough.
dialogue.somali: Toban daqiiqo maalin kasta ayaa ku filan.

dialogue.speaker: Student
dialogue.english: I will try that this week.

title: Meeting Other Students
situation: A new student introduces themselves to other students before class.
somali_situation: Arday cusub ayaa is baraya arday kale ka hor fasalka.

title: Asking About an Exam
situation: A student asks about an upcoming exam, timing, and allowed materials.
somali_situation: Arday ayaa weydiinaya imtixaan soo socda, waqtiga, iyo agabka la oggol yahay.
key_phrases: Bring a pencil, not a dictionary.
When will we get the result?

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.english: Bring a pencil, not a dictionary.
dialogue.somali: Keen qalin qori, qaamuus ha keenin.

dialogue.speaker: Student
dialogue.english: How many exams are this term?
dialogue.somali: Teermkan imtixaano imisa ah baa jira?

dialogue.speaker: Student
dialogue.english: When will we get the result?

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.english: You will get the result next week.
dialogue.somali: Natiijada toddobaadka dambe ayaad heli doontaan.

title: Explaining an Absence
situation: A student explains an absence and asks how to catch up.
somali_situation: Arday ayaa sharxaya maqnaansho wuxuuna weydiinayaa sida uu ula qabsado wixii ka dhacay.
key_phrases: I was absent yesterday because I was sick.
Ask a classmate for the notes.

dialogue.speaker: Student
dialogue.english: I was absent yesterday because I was sick.
dialogue.somali: Shalay waan maqnaa sababtoo ah waan xanuunsanaa.

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.english: I hope you feel better now.
dialogue.somali: Waxaan rajaynayaa inaad hadda ka roon tahay.

dialogue.speaker: Student
dialogue.english: Did I miss an important lesson?

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.somali: Haa, waxaan ku tababarnay wakhti tagey.

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.english: Ask a classmate for the notes.

dialogue.speaker: Student
dialogue.english: Can I also do extra practice?
dialogue.somali: Tababar dheeraad ahna ma samayn karaa?

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.english: Yes, I will send one exercise.
dialogue.somali: Haa, hal layli ayaan kuu diri doonaa.

dialogue.speaker: Student
dialogue.somali: Waad ku mahadsan tahay inaad fahantay.

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.english: Please tell me earlier next time.
dialogue.somali: Fadlan marka xiga hore ii sheeg.

title: Buying School Supplies
situation: A parent and shop assistant choose school supplies for the first week of class.
somali_situation: Waalid iyo kaaliye dukaan ayaa dooranaya agab dugsi oo loogu talagalay toddobaadka koowaad ee fasalka.
key_phrases: I need school supplies for my child.
Does the uniform come in a smaller size?
Add two notebooks and an eraser.
Please keep the receipt for exchanges.

dialogue.speaker: Parent
dialogue.english: I need school supplies for my child.
dialogue.somali: Waxaan u baahanahay agab dugsi oo ilmahayga ah.

dialogue.speaker: Shop Assistant
dialogue.english: What grade is your child in?

dialogue.speaker: Parent
dialogue.somali: Boorsadan dhabarku aad bay u culus tahay.

dialogue.speaker: Parent
dialogue.english: Add two notebooks and an eraser.
dialogue.somali: Ku dar laba buug iyo masax.

dialogue.speaker: Shop Assistant
dialogue.somali: Qalin qorina ma u baahan tahay?

dialogue.speaker: Parent
dialogue.somali: Haa, hal baakad oo qalin qori ah.

dialogue.speaker: Shop Assistant
dialogue.english: The uniform is on the back wall.
dialogue.somali: Labiska dugsigu derbiga dambe ayuu yaal.

dialogue.speaker: Parent
dialogue.english: Does the uniform come in a smaller size?
dialogue.somali: Labiska dugsigu cabbir ka yar ma leeyahay?

dialogue.speaker: Parent
dialogue.english: If it does not fit, can I exchange it?
dialogue.somali: Haddii uusan ku habboonayn, ma beddeli karaa?

dialogue.speaker: Shop Assistant
dialogue.english: Yes, please keep the receipt for exchanges.
dialogue.somali: Haa, fadlan rasiidka hayso beddelka awgiis.

dialogue.speaker: Parent
dialogue.somali: Taasi way caawinaysaa. Dugsigu Isniinta ayuu bilaabmaa.

dialogue.speaker: Shop Assistant
dialogue.english: Then you have everything for the first week.
dialogue.somali: Markaa waxaad haysataa wax kasta oo toddobaadka koowaad ah.

title: Asking About University
situation: A student asks where the university office is and when it opens.
somali_situation: Arday ayaa weydiinaya meesha xafiiska jaamacaddu ku yaal iyo goorta uu furmo.
key_phrases: It is in the main building.

dialogue.speaker: Student
dialogue.somali: Xafiiska jaamacaddu xaggee buu ku yaal?

dialogue.speaker: Security Guard
dialogue.english: It is in the main building.

dialogue.speaker: Student
dialogue.english: Thank you. I am a new student.

title: Fixing an Online Learning Problem
somali_title: Dhibaato waxbarasho internet oo la xallinayo
situation: A learner asks for help joining an online lesson and submitting work.
somali_situation: Arday ayaa caawimaad ka codsanaya ku biirista cashar internet ah iyo gudbinta shaqo.
key_phrases: I cannot join the online learning lesson.

dialogue.speaker: Learner
dialogue.english: I cannot join the online learning lesson.
dialogue.somali: Ma ku biiri karo casharka waxbarashada internetka.

dialogue.speaker: Learner
dialogue.english: The screen asks for a password.
dialogue.somali: Shaashaddu waxay codsanaysaa eray sir ah.

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.somali: Si taxaddar leh u geli erayga sirta ah.

dialogue.speaker: Learner
dialogue.english: I am in the lesson now.

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.english: Good. Can you hear me now?
dialogue.somali: Waa fiican tahay. Hadda ma i maqli kartaa?

dialogue.speaker: Learner
dialogue.english: Yes. When should I send the homework?
dialogue.somali: Haa. Goormaan soo diraa shaqada guriga?
